turns.prompt_text: what does heart rate variability mean
turns.response_html: Heart rate variability is the natural fluctuation in the time interval between consecutive heartbeats. This variation reflects the balance between your sympathetic ("fight or flight") and parasympathetic ("rest and digest") nervous systems. A higher variability generally indicates a healthier, more adaptable cardiovascular system.
